title: Multi-creator video selling the Ivy product

segments.text: Got a bit of an idea that's interesting for a video, which is to sell the Ivy product itself. It's to get several creators and have them talking to the device, with the hook being that the ideas are connected into something like Mr. Beast's.
That viral video I was watching the other day on YouTube — if you can find it.

The video should be pretty short. I'm thinking we have it in different hands and different people, and that the goal of the video is to make the product, then the AI, then the output, and then a video all really seamless, all really fun.
And I think fun is the goal — to make the UI and the AI really personable and really, I guess, optimistic around great ideas and talkative, and we can show the visuals of that.
Like to have your thoughts on it and put together some ideas and storyboards and even some demo concepts.

cards.title: Several creators talking to the device
cards.gist: A short video selling the Ivy product itself by having several creators talk to the device in different hands, with the hook that their ideas get connected — making product, AI, output and finished video feel seamless and fun.

loose_ends.text: Find the MrBeast viral video on YouTube she was watching the other day
